method: Actual native image tool inspection of all three PNGs and a contact sheet sampled from the encoded GIF; no browser opened for review.
findings: Actual 390x900 shared Taro pages retain the company wordmark, blue accent and single-column form; no horizontal clipping observed in checked regions.
The editor capture is scrolled to the revised complete proposal and blank dates; the remaining budget/file controls are outside this viewport.
The approved detail displays the exact fixed proposal revision and original request link; approval does not itself show an implemented project.
The budget screenshot shows an explicitly filtered HKD approved revision with a zero-line total after the separately implemented clearing proposal.
Actual GIF samples show initial proposal creation, a 100.01 replacement line and the resulting immutable draft detail. Later screenshots show the separate 120.01 revised proposal.
No password, MFA code or token is visible in sampled pixels; public synthetic business identifiers are intentionally retained.
limits: The 7.3-second silent recording runs at automation speed. Three sampled GIF frames do not review every encoded pixel or establish real-device, cloud, model, Telegram or production acceptance.
